dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: So, you recommend Chioriya Boutique's seasonal children's clothing line?

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Eloffe often invites Kiara to Chioriya Boutique to try on outfits, and they take a bunch of photos! They're all adorable, too.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: In that case, I shall place an order.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Great timing! Monsieur Neuvillette's added a new stop to his itinerary, and we were just discussing what kind of gifts to bring!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: A rare opportunity to take a vacation has arisen, and I plan to use it to visit the Melusines in Merusea Village.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: It has been some time since my last visit, and as such meetings are hard to come by, I wish to prepare some gifts.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: As you are here, might I solicit your advice?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I believe you have already befriended a number of Melusines. As such, your insights would be most valuable.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I have a Melusine friend who loves to paint.

response.speaker: Sedene
response.text: Oh, right! I remember! Serene's letters mentioned that Mamere has always been passionate about art!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Indeed. Given the environmental variations there, some waterproof paints would make a good gift.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There's no Melusine who doesn't like mechanical components.

response.speaker: Sedene
response.text: Yeah, that's true! I can help pick some! The clockwork workshops usually sell spare components at a discount, and clockwork toys too.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Then I shall leave their procurement to you. Thank you.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Prioritize what you like, without regard to cost. I will ensure you have an ample budget.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can never go wrong with making food.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Oh... I fear my culinary experience only extends to making soups...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Sedene, are there any foods particularly popular among the Melusines recently?

response.speaker: Sedene
response.text: Let me think... Yeah... cakes, macarons, Blubber Profiterole, Pate de Fruit...

response.speaker: Sedene
response.text: Oh right, and lots of snacks like Feast-O's, and Fonta!

choices.text: It's okay to eat stuff like that in moderation.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I understand.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Everyone has different tastes. And in the interests of fairness and justice, we should have prepared a greater variety of gifts from the start.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: It is decided. Every one of those ideas shall be adopted.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Thank you both for your suggestions. Once the purchases have been made, I will have someone package them up and send each to their respective recipients.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Sedene, I believe your delivery address is still the Palais Mermonia, yes?

response.speaker: Sedene
response.text: Huh? Me? I get a present too? But aren't they for everyone in Merusea Village?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Of course. As I said, opportunities like this are hard to come by, so every Melusine should receive a gift.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: And you are a Melusine too, are you not?

response.speaker: Sedene
response.text: Yeah! Thank you, Monsieur Neuvillette!

choices.text: As long as they're happy, right?
